announcements.headline: Restoration - Caspian Sunrise Plc
announcements.insight: Caspian Sunrise Plc has restored its listing following a period of delays to interim results. Shareholders should monitor subsequent operational updates for clarity on the Tau-Cen acquisition integration.

announcements.headline: Interim results for six months ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Interim results are now published following a suspension and acquisition completion. Shareholders should assess the financial impact of the Tau-Cen deal.

announcements.headline: Operational update
announcements.insight: Operations update follows suspension and Tau-Cen acquisition completion. Shareholders should monitor progress on financial reporting delays.

announcements.headline: Completion of the acquisition of Tau-Cen
announcements.insight: Completion of Tau-Cen acquisition follows prior suspension and operational updates. This resolves earlier uncertainty regarding financial reporting delays.

announcements.headline: Delay to Publication of Interim Results
announcements.insight: Shares remain suspended following the August update. Shareholders must await further developments regarding operations and financial reporting.

announcements.headline: Operations, acquisitions & financial reporting
announcements.insight: Shares remain suspended since July following delayed results. The new filing regarding operations and acquisitions suggests a potential resolution to the suspension.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Caspian Sunrise Plc
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following the delay to publish results. Shareholders should watch for further updates regarding the publication of financial statements.

announcements.headline: Delay to Publication of 31 Dec 2025 Results
announcements.insight: Caspian Sunrise delays its 31 Dec 2025 results publication. Shareholders should watch for the new release date.
